summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-flaky-worker as inventory-worker with systemd Restart=on-failure. Automatic recovery and persistence across a full node reboot were verified.
actions_performed: Installed, validated, enabled, and started inventory-worker.service.
Verified recovery from the worker’s intentional exit-code failure.
Verified recovery from a controlled SIGKILL to the running service.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed and the service recovered.

evidence.requirement: Worker runs as inventory-worker with automatic failure recovery
evidence.summary: The initial worker invocation exited 1 and systemd restarted it. A subsequent controlled SIGKILL increased NRestarts from 1 to 2 and produced a new healthy process running as inventory-worker.

evidence.requirement: Service configuration is enabled and uses the required executable
evidence.summary: The validated and enabled unit uses /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-flaky-worker, User=inventory-worker, Group=inventory-worker, and Restart=on-failure.

Healthy pre-reboot boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured; a safe reboot was acknowledged; the boot ID changed to dbba5e8a-a070-4ac8-80b5-7201669d789c; afterward the enabled service was active with PID 697 under inventory-worker, its state persisted, and no failed units remained.
